definitions.explanation: The outermost surface of the earth. Used in geography, science, and general descriptions of things on or near the ground level.

examples.japanese: {地表|ちひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}した→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
⟦{雨水|あまみず}→雨水：14607_amamizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{地表|ちひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧いく。
examples.english: Rainwater flows across the ground surface.

examples.japanese: {地表|ちひょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}さ→深さ：05328_fukasa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ruins were discovered at a depth of several meters from the surface.

notes:
{地表|ちひょう} refers to the outermost surface of the earth. Commonly used in scientific, geographical, and environmental contexts.

FORMS:
{地|ち} (earth, ground) + ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (surface). Compare with ⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧ (⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ = sea surface).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地表|ちひょう}⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: ground surface temperature
- {地表|ちひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧: near the surface
- {地表|ちひょう}⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: vicinity of the surface
- {地表|ちひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|おお}う→覆う：02020_oou⟧: to cover the surface
- {地表|ちひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到達|とうたつ}→到達：11815_toutatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reach the surface

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧: underground (below the surface)
- ⟦{地中|ちちゅう}→地中：12135_chichuu⟧: in the ground (embedded)
- ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧: the ground (everyday word for ground surface)
- ⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧: sea surface
{地表|ちひょう} is more scientific/formal than ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧, which is the everyday word for the ground you walk on.
